boundaries.evidence: The Definition inherits the all-dimension-vector direct sum and additive value-set condition.
The Definition assigns Q with its identity class to dimension zero.
Definition includes dimension-one components for every allowed critical value.
The Definition allows empty critical fibers; their supported coefficient complexes are zero.
Definition identifies zero-subobject and whole-subobject products as the unit cases.
The coefficient datum is supplied as input and the definition selects no representative.
